stem.text: A car accelerates from rest. The graph shows the variation of the momentum of the car with time.

stem.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled momentum and the horizontal axis labelled time; a curve starts at the origin and rises.

stem.text: What is the meaning of the gradient of the graph at a particular time?

A.text: the kinetic energy of the car

B.text: the rate of change of kinetic energy of the car

C.text: the resultant force on the car
